caption:
The Swedish warship Vasa sank in 1628 after sailing only about 1,300 metres on her maiden voyage.

In 1628, the royal warship Vasa set sail from Stockholm harbour. A sudden gust of wind caused the top-heavy vessel to heel over, allowing water to flood open gun ports and sink her within minutes before crowds of onlookers.

Visuals created with AI.
